description: Returns numbers for comparing a deck's structure: the median slide count and, for each section, the share of decks that have it and the median slide where it first appears. Use it to check a deck's length or order against the library, optionally for one stage or outcome. For what each section means, call list_sections; for example slides, call search_slides. Only decks with a full slide list are counted, and appendix slides are left out. The result has decks_compared, median_slides, middle_half (the 25th and 75th percentile slide counts) and sections, each with id, name, share_of_decks and median_first_slide.

outcome.description: How the raise went. "funded" is decks that raised the round; "failed" covers rounds that did not close and first versions that investors rejected. Leave out for both.

stage.description: Round stage. "early" is pre-seed and angel rounds; "seed" is seed rounds. Leave out for every stage.

name: section_benchmarks
title: Get section benchmarks
